Evaluate each named criterion independently
against its extracted value and the complete arguments of this SAME tool call.
Return one Boolean verdict and a concise evidence-based reason per check_id.
Do not combine criteria into a holistic score or add requirements.

Use the request and same-call arguments to resolve names, pronouns, abbreviations,
and intended authorship. Accept equivalent wording that communicates the required
meaning. A first-person document written for the requesting user can refer to
that user as I; do not demand repetition of a name when authorship is clear.
The request and criteria are not evidence that the action included an answer.
Missing, incomplete, ambiguous, contradictory, or negated REQUIRED meaning fails.
Do not confuse mentioning a forbidden claim in an explicit denial with making
that claim. Do not obtain missing content from another call or criterion.

Return only JSON: {"results": [{"check_id": "supplied ID", "passed": true,
"reason": "exact supporting text or missing requirement"}]}.
Include every supplied check_id exactly once and no additional IDs.

{"user_request": "Create a compact archival ownership card titled “July 2023 analysis ownership card” for the Operating Archive. Cover the Helio Start baseline analysis and retained-mid expansion eligibility analysis as two distinct lanes, identify the default owner for each, and make clear that these assignments were limited to July 2023 rather than a current standing org rule.", "today": "2028-01-01", "tool": "create_doc", "arguments": {"title": "July 2023 analysis ownership card", "folder": "Operating Archive", "body": "JULY 2023 — ARCHIVAL OWNERSHIP CARD

Scope: A practical, non-permanent working split agreed for July 2023. Not a current standing org rule, formal process, or org-chart assignment.

Lane 1 — Helio Start baseline analysis
Default owner: Owen
Owns the first-pass baseline readout shape and makes the underlying segment boundaries visible.

Lane 2 — Retained-mid expansion eligibility analysis
Default owner: Owen
Owns the eligibility cuts and readout shape for retained-mid expansion.

Boundary: These default-owner assignments applied only to July 2023 work. They should not be treated as current ownership without a new, explicit assignment."}, "checks": [{"check_id": "riley_120_03", "path": "args", "criterion": "The created document must clearly function as an archival July 2023 ownership card and state that Owen was the default owner for each of two separate analysis lanes: (1) the Helio Start baseline readout shape and (2) the retained-mid expansion eligibility cuts. It must also clearly limit this assignment to July 2023 and avoid presenting it as a current or permanent org rule. Missing, merging, or contradicting either lane, owner, or time limitation must fail.", "value": {"title": "July 2023 analysis ownership card", "folder": "Operating Archive", "body": "JULY 2023 — ARCHIVAL OWNERSHIP CARD

{"results":[{"check_id":"riley_120_03","passed":true,"reason":"The document is titled “July 2023 analysis ownership card,” is filed in “Operating Archive,” and labels itself “JULY 2023 — ARCHIVAL OWNERSHIP CARD.” It separates “Lane 1 — Helio Start baseline analysis” from “Lane 2 — Retained-mid expansion eligibility analysis,” names “Default owner: Owen” for both, and assigns him the baseline “readout shape” and retained-mid “eligibility cuts,” respectively. It explicitly says the split was “non-permanent,” “applied only to July 2023 work,” and is “Not a current standing org rule.”"}]}
